criteria.question: Does inhabited infrastructure and actual figure fraction establish immense scale without relying on a large close hero?
criteria.evidence: Visible small doors/people against at least two depth planes and one dominant city mass.

criteria.question: Can the viewer identify who wants what, what physically prevents it, and what worsens if they wait?
criteria.evidence: Contested route/person/object and a visible closing gap, arriving force or lost support.

criteria.question: Can source, action, target and visible consequence be traced?
criteria.evidence: One main effect with real contact or a clearly established spatial link; chronology may use adjacent images.

criteria.question: Are body-to-arm-to-hand-to-weapon and front/rear function coherent?
criteria.evidence: Continuous limbs and weapons, actual gripping positions, shield outer face toward incoming force.

criteria.question: Do identity, equipment, direction and damage persist through linked moments?
criteria.evidence: Same source-derived costume/face, two stable landmarks, unchanged axis, broken structure remains broken.

criteria.question: Do broad values reduce eye strain while preserving material, inhabited detail, depth and focal precision?
criteria.evidence: Native and matched phone views; quiet surface interiors with meaningful contour/contact detail.

criteria.question: Does the power have a visible limit and a consequence that changes relationships or the city?
criteria.evidence: Growth increases reach/control without removing the core limitation; choices have costs.

provisional_mechanics: The Unspent Blow: capture one pressure front and choose a discharge target
Winter Lock: contact-water ice arrests a loaded joint
The Still Crown: one fixed local structure while adjacent city continues moving

close_action.note: Controlling detail may exceed 50%; deliberate figure crops allowed

assessment_limits: These are visual review criteria, not automatic metrics or acceptance tests.
